key_insight: Friction stir welding joined 1-mm NiTi sheet to AA6061 successfully, produced mixed results with AA2024, and failed to join AA7075 under the tested conditions.
engineering_relevance: The process could integrate shape memory NiTi with aerospace aluminum structures, but alloy selection strongly affects joint integrity and strength.
method: Friction stir weld dissimilar butt joints of NiTi with three aluminum alloys.
Evaluate joint strength and ductility through tensile testing.
Examine interface and stir-zone microstructures using microscopy.
evidence_signal: AA6061–NiTi welds averaged 167.8 MPa ultimate tensile strength and 57.9% weld efficiency, versus 120 MPa and 27.6% for AA2024–NiTi welds.
watch_item: Post-weld cracking in AA2024 and AA7075 was attributed to thermal-expansion mismatch, residual stresses, and lower ductility, limiting reliability under the tested conditions.
paper_title: Exploration of friction stir welding butted thin sheet NiTi with AA6061, AA2024, and AA7075
